resolved_findings.original_issue: No retry idempotency: a committed response with a lost 201 could be duplicated, losing its deletion receipt.
resolved_findings.correction_checked: Client-generated UUID and deletion secret; saved unique ID and HMAC payload fingerprint; exact retry returns existing receipt before Siteverify. Same receipt with changed payload conflicts. Across-midnight pending retry remains stable.

resolved_findings.original_issue: The required privacy version and optional-contact consent were checked but not retained.
resolved_findings.correction_checked: Response/contact tables now retain privacy_version and consent_at; optional contact is stored only with affirmative contact consent. Tested in synthetic persistence.

controls_observed: Strict accepted-field and enum/range/date validation; no file upload or unrestricted case narrative.
Server checks Turnstile success, hostname and action. Origin allowlist is not presented as authentication.
Prepared SQL; awaited D1 batch before accepted success; generic database/service failures do not echo a submitted body.
Optional email separate and AES-GCM encrypted; response stores deletion-secret hash, not its cleartext.
Separate admin bearer secret; no public raw-response read route.
Daily expiry cleanup; no raw IP is stored by application code, but a keyed short-lived abuse identifier is stored and Cloudflare still processes network data.
limits: Independent synthetic endpoint checks use an in-memory D1 stand-in and a controlled Siteverify response, not real users or a deployed endpoint.

They do not establish production secret configuration, Cloudflare D1 transaction behavior, cron execution, browser storage/privacy copy, email follow-up tooling, provider logging/backup retention, or one-response-per-person validity.
D1 atomic batches and Turnstile single-use behavior were separately checked against official provider documentation.

findings_pending_or_to_recheck.finding: The original concluded_duration definition universally asserts submission-to-first-instance-resolution. Native MSWiA18089 does not expressly define the source-system start event. Use reported administrative duration, and specify endpoints only where the particular source defines them.

The new round2-data report calls 445458 a forecast-page portal snapshot and suggests retrieval/revision explanations. The established evidence is forecast text445458 versus inspected CSV/API445462. No old CSV or revision has been established.

The finished notice and form must match the actual exact dates and optional sensitive/linkable combinations, separate contact consent, client receipt storage, deletion route and daily retention cleanup. Do not claim anonymity or that all Cloudflare processing stays in the EU from the D1 jurisdiction alone.

Synthetic tests do not prove deployed secrets, allowed Turnstile hostname/action, D1 binding/schema, EU storage setting, cron, observability/provider processing, restricted admin access, operational email follow-up/deletion or browser request handling. The collection gate stays off until the controller/notice/configuration are ready.
